name: Traffic Safety Committee Meeting
minutes_text:
ACTION MEMO
  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

Council Chambers - City Hall  Wednesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  September 11, 2013
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  7:30 PM

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Committee Members Beall, Garland, Kao, Vice-Chair King, and
  Chairman Buss present.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
  None.

OLD BUSINESS
1. Via Tejon resident parking only request.

  Action: Continue Item. Direct Staff to evaluate the parking availability, restrictions and
  usage in the Malaga Cove Plaza and City Hall area, and bring back a report to the Traffic
  Safety Committee at the October 2013 meeting.

NEW BUSINESS
2. U-Turn Restrictions and “DO NOT BLOCK DRIVEWAY” signs at Lunada Bay Elementary
  School.

  Action: Recommend that Staff: 1) Install signs to prohibit U-Turns during school hours on
  Paseo Lunado between Via Alvarado and Via Anacapa; and, 2) Install “DO NOT BLOCK
  DRIVEWAY” signs at the entrance and exit to the school driveway on Paseo Lunado.
  Approved (5-0).

RESIDENT LETTERS
3. Via Almar traffic calming petition.

  Action: Continue Item. Direct Staff to work with the residents on Via Almar to evaluate
  traffic conditions, develop traffic calming recommendations and bring back a report to the
  Traffic Safety Committee.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on Tuesday, September 24, 2013.

Traffic Safety Committee  1  Director ______
Action Memo
September 11, 2013
 4. Via Acalones speeding.
5. Via La Brea at Via Acalones traffic control request.
6. Via Acalones various traffic issues.

  Action: Continue Item. Direct Staff to work with the residents on Via Acalones to evaluate
  traffic conditions, develop traffic recommendations to address each of their concerns and
  bring back a report to the Traffic Safety Committee.

7. Traffic directional controls in 300 block of Paseo Del Mar

  Action: Recommend that Staff reinstall directional signage and pavement markings to
  provide counterclockwise traffic flow in the 300 block of Paseo Del Mar and parking lot.
  Approved (5-0).

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM STAFF/COMMITTEE

8. September 10, 2013 City Council Action Minutes
  Item 2 – Adoption of Ordinance 13-702, establishing prima facie speed limits

9. Staff Items of Information for the Committee

ADJOURNMENT TO OCTOBER 9, 2013.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on Tuesday, September 24, 2013.
